result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic signals, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads or traffic calming measures like curb extensions to reduce exposure in this mixed-use environment.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian signal heads are present at this signalized intersection to indicate safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection where traffic lights are mounted.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without the benefit of curb extensions or refuge islands.
hazards.location_in_image: The zebra crosswalk spanning the width of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure parking is restricted near the crosswalk to maintain clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and wide sidewalks, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of a large truck near the crossing create significant sightline and navigational challenges.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large delivery truck is positioned near the crosswalk, potentially blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk markings.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, requiring pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety for people crossing.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and standing near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a high-visibility crosswalk across the side street. However, the main thoroughfare lacks marked crossings, and parked vehicles near the corners may create sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: No marked crosswalk is visible across the primary road in the foreground, increasing exposure for pedestrians crossing that leg.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the side street curb may block the visibility of pedestrians for turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street

interventions.title: Complete Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalks to all legs of the intersection to provide a continuous pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to clarify right-of-way and crossing time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and a large concrete refuge island, providing some protection for pedestrians. However, the wide roadway and presence of multiple travel lanes suggest a car-oriented environment with significant crossing exposure.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the image may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, near the residential buildings.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their time in the conflict zone despite the presence of a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
